definitions: A chemical substance produced and released into the environment by an animal, especially a mammal or an insect, affecting the behavior or physiology of others of its species.
Any of various chemical substances, often odors, released by an animal that influence the behavior or development of other members of the same species, e.g., by attracting mates.
examples: The moth releases pheromones to attract a mate.
Scientists study how pheromones influence animal behavior.
Some insects use pheromones as an alarm signal.
